title: The wonderful Itálica
text: The history was the most memorable part for me. Our guide, Miguel, was knowledgeable and personable - you could see he really enjoyed his work! There is so much more that hasn’t been excavated yet, so hopefully it Itálica will receive more funds in the future so that they can continue their amazing work!
author: Andrea_P

title: Worthwhile!!
text: Our guide Yohanna was warm and humerus. She kept the group on track without being pushy! The tempo was good and she provided ample historical information. The sight is amazing, much larger than expected! A must do outing (1/2 day) while in Seville
author: Heidemarie_R

title: Excellent
text: It was a good tour with a great guide. I would however like a credit on our Gibralter tour which we missed due to misinformation.  We would like to take Viator tour from Madrid.
author: Carole_K

title: Great tour from Seville
text: Our guide Luca was great.  Italica is definitely a must see.  English explanation is great especially to learn about the culture and history.
author: Roam22575756088

title: Very Interesting
text: The tour guide was very knowledgeable and he was able to provide a tour to both Spanish speakers and English speakers by transitioning back and forth between Spanish and English.
author: Melanie_K

title: A great tour (not a wine tour)
text: We thought we were going on a wine tour. No wine but the tour was excellent   Learned a greatdealaboutRan history in this area.  Guidewas excellent
author: Paul_K
